inputs.name: ticks

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.name: seed

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: The action space is a Box whose low is -0.8 and whose high is 0.8 on every element
The default hand model declares a timestep of 0.01 s
The gym registration is kinovagripper-v0 with max_episode_steps 100
reset takes shape_keys and hand_orientation as positional arguments
step returns the observation, reward, done flag and info as a four-tuple
seed stores the numpy random generator and returns the seed in a list
An action whose length is 4 is padded with two zeros to 6 values
The local observation documentation runs from index 0 to index 81
The lift reward is 50.0 and done becomes true when the object z is within 0.005 of the target or above it
Python 3.7 and MuJoCo 1.50 are the documented requirements

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the placeholders of the initial hand and object pose and the integration is arithmetic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory; the fake draws with Python's random.Random and was not compared with the upstream numpy stream

gaps: the fake is analytic (F0): it does not run MuJoCo and models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator forces, sensor noise or the grasp classifier

the upstream environment is legacy gym: reset(shape_keys, hand_orientation) needs two positional arguments and step returns a four-tuple (kinova_gripper_env.py:1310, :1552); the fake implements the gymnasium reset(seed, options) and five-tuple API the bridge calls, and the two required legacy arguments are accepted through reset options instead

the fake returns the 48-element observation declared by observation_space (kinova_gripper_env.py:211-237); the local _get_obs() documentation describes 82 elements (kinova_gripper_env.py:440-454), which the fake does not reproduce
the initial hand/object pose, object size and finger distances are placeholders, not samples from the upstream coordinate files or object XML models
the 30-step class attribute and the 100-step gym registration are not enforced as a time limit; the fake only reports done from the lift-reward rule (kinova_gripper_env.py:661-663)
MuJoCo 1.50, mujoco-py, a C compiler and a MuJoCo licence key are required upstream (README.md:7-10); they were not installed and the upstream simulator was never opened or compared

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
